baseline.native_recipe: Part.makeBox(2,3,4), Tag=1, copy Seed with a separate App.StringHasher, then fuse with a copy translated by (1,0,0). Native operations create genuine SID-backed names and recursive Related IDs, without assigning a handwritten ElementMap.
baseline.minimal_red: 1 failure in0.074s: assignment changes the owning hasher, and native IDs3,6,9,11,13 become absent from the assigned shape hasher.
baseline.regression_red: The first five regression methods all fail in0.093s before the fix. Numeric collisions can resolve foreign IDs to unrelated data; assigning a mapless shape can clear another shape's shared table. A sixth source-document-closure regression was added during review.

cause: Python shape assignment constructed a retagged result with the document primary hasher while copying source names and SID references. The raw names retained their source identity domain. A separate mapless branch also destructively cleared a borrowed shared hasher.

fix.assignment: Retain a non-null source hasher while retagging, otherwise use the existing document fallback. This matches the existing C++ setValue source-first policy.
fix.shared_lifetime: Do not clear an input hasher merely because this particular shape has no map or tag.
fix.persistence: Use existing per-property HasherIndex/save/restore registration. No file-format change, recursive translation, SaveAll workaround, reference reassignment or map clearing is introduced.
